FRONT.label: front view
FRONT.instruction: Render a direct front view with symmetrical body alignment, clear full-body proportions, and no rotation away from camera.

FRONT_LEFT_3_4.label: front-left 3/4 view
FRONT_LEFT_3_4.instruction: Render a front-left three-quarter body reference. The body faces mostly forward with the character's left side rotating slightly toward camera while preserving readable full-body proportions.

FRONT_RIGHT_3_4.label: front-right 3/4 view
FRONT_RIGHT_3_4.instruction: Render a front-right three-quarter body reference. The body faces mostly forward with the character's right side rotating slightly toward camera while preserving readable full-body proportions.

LEFT_PROFILE.label: left profile view
LEFT_PROFILE.instruction: Render a strict left profile body reference with the character's left side facing camera, clear torso depth, limb alignment, and a neutral readable silhouette.

RIGHT_PROFILE.label: right profile view
RIGHT_PROFILE.instruction: Render a strict right profile body reference with the character's right side facing camera, clear torso depth, limb alignment, and a neutral readable silhouette.

BACK_LEFT_3_4.label: back-left 3/4 view
BACK_LEFT_3_4.instruction: Render a back-left three-quarter body reference. The back is dominant, with the character's left side slightly visible and the full-body silhouette kept clear.

BACK_RIGHT_3_4.label: back-right 3/4 view
BACK_RIGHT_3_4.instruction: Render a back-right three-quarter body reference. The back is dominant, with the character's right side slightly visible and the full-body silhouette kept clear.

BACK.label: back view
BACK.instruction: Render a direct back view with balanced shoulder and hip alignment, clear full-body proportions, and no turn toward camera.
